pool_frame_review.reviewer: Claude (Opus 5), reading the STAGED POOL sheets
pool_frame_review.status: COMPLETE -- all 135 sheets read at 6+ samples per clip
pool_frame_review.sampling: every clip at 6+ frames (min 6, median 6, max 12), per the main thread's instruction after a 3-frame sheet passed a clip that broke mid-way
pool_frame_review.basis: forbidden = episode_spec.v003 forbidden_subjects or an identifiable person. off_register = breaks no rule, belongs to another film; my call, overrulable.
pool_frame_review.note: THIS IS NOT A SHIP DECISION. Per the main thread (2026-08-22), ship is decided by a human reading contact sheets of the ACTUAL RENDER. All this file proves is that bad clips were taken out of the pool before assembly.

already_out_of_pool.pexels_v_10139699: Reviewed and rejected here, then found NOT to be in the staged pool -- it was already in remotion/public/lahaina/factory_rejected/. The contact sheets were built from a snapshot one clip older than the pool. The verdict agrees with the earlier one; recorded so the count difference (135 sheets cover 375 clips, the pool holds 374) is not read as an error.

conditional.pexels_v_18295465: embers and sparks rising on black. Usable, but ONLY cropped off the barrel rim visible at the bottom of the frame -- uncropped it reads as a burn barrel
conditional.pexels_v_26628206: smouldering ground among standing trunks. Usable ONLY framed tight enough that the trunks do not read as a forest -- see the conifer rejection above for why that distinction matters here
conditional.pexels_v_26654895: wide burnt scrub, the right fuel and the right restraint. Avoid ~5.9 s: something crosses the lens close and blurred
conditional.pexels_v_29185898: a log pile burning down to white ash. No pit edge visible, so usable tight and short -- but it is still a bonfire if it runs long
conditional.pexels_v_29702246: a real wildfire from the air, with an orange flame line visible in four of six samples. Nothing forbids it -- the trees are bare deciduous, not conifer -- but the bible's register is smoke at distance, so use the smoke-only frames unless the beat needs the flame
conditional.pexels_v_30043379: backlit silhouettes of legs on a pavement, long shadows, no faces at all. Safe on likeness. Use for an ordinary morning, never near the evacuation beats -- `people fleeing fire` is forbidden and context would supply the meaning the frame does not
conditional.pexels_v_31130130: straight down onto an active flame front, bright orange in all six samples. Nothing forbids it, but this is the one clip where fire is the subject rather than the smoke. Use only if a beat needs the fire itself
conditional.pexels_v_31901299: US freeway congestion under an overpass -- on register, unlike the other windscreen clips, which were rain and rural. The bonnet fills the bottom third and crops away cleanly. Usable cropped, not as shot
conditional.pexels_v_3234833: 58 s of pale dry grass on an open slope -- the right fuel, and long enough to cut several ways. Stop before ~46 s: the last third drifts to frost on reeds beside water, which is the wrong climate entirely
conditional.pexels_v_33638048: a flame line across a harvested field. THE PROBLEM IS THE GEOMETRY: the ignition line is dead straight and the ground is ploughed into rows, so it reads as a managed burn. forbidden_claims bars any suggestion the fire was set. Usable only framed tight enough to lose the straight line
conditional.pexels_v_33643170: the same agricultural burn seen serpentine from above -- same constraint
conditional.pexels_v_33643208: a third stubble burn, close aerial -- same constraint. Noting all three together because agricultural burns are where nearly all stock GRASS fire comes from. Dropping the category outright would leave the film with no fire in the right fuel at all, so they are constrained, not cut
conditional.pexels_v_34535507: a man silhouetted at a window looking out over a dry plain. Fully black, no features, so no likeness problem. The real question is editorial and belongs to whoever cuts it: this film names no victim and shows none, and a lone figure at a window placed near the fire or the deaths would be read as one. Safe over ordinary-morning narration, nowhere else
conditional.pexels_v_34535510: the same man crossing the window. Same call, same constraint
conditional.pexels_v_38779095: A TRAFFIC CONTROL ROOM -- wall of monitors, operators at desks. This is the emergency-operations register the film needs and there is nothing else like it in the pool. Two constraints: operators are in frame (backs mostly, one profile at 4.3 s) and the wall content is legible. Use framings without a resolvable face, and never let a caption or the narration imply this room is Maui's
conditional.pexels_v_38779099: a second control room, operator in a headset. Same two constraints
conditional.pexels_v_38779100: a third, wider, someone standing at the wall pointing. Same constraints
conditional.pexels_v_38779103: a fourth, with a man walking through the foreground. Same constraints
conditional.pexels_v_38957773: HIGHEST LIKENESS RISK FOUND SO FAR. Firefighters kneeling over a hose and gear at a kerb -- exactly the response register the film wants, and their faces resolve clearly in 5 of 6 samples. `real_person_likeness` is one of the four classes that closes the door. Usable ONLY cropped to hose, hands and gear, and never over narration about named responders. If in doubt, drop it -- the film survives without it
conditional.pexels_v_4320603: thin smoke wisps on black, off_label on every sample. This is studio smoke -- incense scale, lit from the side. Fine as an overlay or a transition texture, never as a depiction of this fire's smoke
conditional.pexels_v_4320605: the same studio smoke, denser. Same constraint
conditional.pexels_v_5339613: 38.5 s of dusk cloud with the sun breaking through -- good, but stop at about 30 s. The last two samples are near-black and off_label
conditional.pexels_v_5941611: white smoke drifting over a town from the air -- good smoke, but the town underneath reads European and `european street` is a forbidden_subject. Usable only in the frames where the smoke fills enough of the picture that the architecture cannot be read
conditional.pexels_v_6894947: 52 s of white studio smoke on black, off_label on 6 samples. Same constraint as 4320603 -- overlay or transition texture, never presented as this fire's smoke
conditional.pexels_v_7122113: 23 s more of the same studio smoke. Same constraint
conditional.pexels_v_7003581: 103 s of heavy structural timbers burning down under thick smoke. Long, and unlike the fire pits this genuinely reads as a burnt STRUCTURE rather than a campfire. Use tight, and never in a way that answers how the fire started
conditional.pexels_v_7710456: someone working through ring binders and loose paper at a table. Her face is visible in the FIRST sample and out of frame in the other five. Usable from about 5 s onward, not from the head
conditional.pexels_v_7955459: 17 s of a grass fire running along a stubble edge with white smoke and no people in it. The best-looking of the agricultural burns and the flame front is irregular rather than ruled -- but it is still a field being burnt, so the same constraint as 33638048 applies
conditional.pexels_v_855024: 10 s of white studio smoke on black, off_label on 3. Overlay only, same constraint as the other studio smoke
conditional.pexels_v_857183: ground-level dust thrown up as a vehicle passes. Start at about 2.4 s -- the first sample has the car and two figures in it, the rest is dust
conditional.pexels_v_9305508: a phone held up with a COMPLETELY BLANK white screen. The blank screen is exactly right; a face sits soft and partial at the left edge. Crop it, or use only the samples framed on the hand
conditional.pexels_v_9694233: 43 s of thick white smoke billowing on black -- the best of the studio smoke by a distance, and at this volume it reads as real. Still an overlay, still not this fire
conditional.pexels_v_9694808: 41 s of thin drifting haze on black. Overlay
